summary: The MCP owner execution (mcp_capability_execute_owner, readOnly false) passes --owner-direct to typed-execute, so the owner's typed claw_execute runs like the owner text path (e.g. WhatsApp messaging.send from the Claude chat). Read-only methods, previews, other callers and other surfaces never carry the flag. The samantha_web hint also asks for a short keyword query (200 characters at most). Public web budget raised from 30 to 40 s (PUBLIC_WEB_BUDGET_MS in runWeb.ts and model-fast-path.py, bounds in claw-capability.py, gemini-request.py, codex-web-request.mjs; typed web helper ceiling 45 → 50 s), with samantha-ui-playbooks #397.
reason: S24 04/11 18:25: a typed WhatsApp send from the Claude chat (profile chat-owner) was refused read_only_policy. Amine 04/11 19:05 (S24 decision 3b693cd2…): no constraint on sending a WhatsApp message at his request from the Claude chat, Samantha voice or elsewhere. Web series 04/11 19:15 (recette-webseries-4): the brain sent a 230-character query, refused by the schema (maxLength 200) before the search. Same series: the Codex search for « dernières nouvelles sur l'iPhone 18 » exceeded 30 s (deadline_exceeded at 33.6 s) while others took 18-22 s; Amine 04/11: « Ok 40 ».
